atomicity.reason: One obligation - a single publication period with its tolerance.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained on the timing, but the obligation's validity window rests on 'for as long as the system is awake', a power state this requirement neither defines nor points to, so the reader must infer when the obligation starts and stops.
comprehensibility.suggestion: Reference the project's defined power state or state machine (naming the state) instead of the informal 'awake'.

feasibility.reason: A 100 ms cyclic message with 10 ms jitter is routine on an automotive vehicle bus.

parent_fit.reason: Defines the reporting cadence of the very value the parent story asks the pack to report on the vehicle interface, a distinct part of that reporting obligation.

unambiguity.reason: One reading - the second sentence pins the tolerance to each individual interval rather than to an average.

verifiability.reason: 100 ms period, 10 ms tolerance and an explicitly stated violation criterion (no publication within 110 ms of the previous one) make this a direct bus-trace check.

summary: Tight, well-quantified timing requirement that even states its own violation criterion; the only gap is the undefined 'awake' state that scopes the obligation.
